name: Flower Boy Delight
source:
Flower Boy Delight is about a girl named Renee. She’s about to graduate from high school in a couple of days, when she decides to get a job to help support her single mother. Not just any job. She goes to the place where her mother and father met for the first time and fell in love all those years ago. With their story fresh in her mind, she begins to work at the restaurant, Rose Delight. Will fate lead her to a love story like her parents?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=40243]Lemma Soft[/url]]
translation:
《花美男的喜悦》讲述的是一个名叫蕾妮的女孩的故事。几天后她即将从高中毕业，此时她决定找一份工作来帮助养活她的单身母亲。不只是任何工作。她去了多年前她父母第一次见面并相爱的地方。她对他们的故事记忆犹新，开始在Rose Delight餐厅工作。命运会带领她走向父母一样的爱情故事吗？

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=40243]Lemma Soft[/url]]
